t: Etching Acid is used to chemically develop $(l:components/pcb)PCB's/$. Etching Acid is made in a $(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber)Pressure Chamber/$ and used in the $(l:manufacturing/etching_tank)Etching Tank/$.$(p)See the $(l:components/pcb)PCB's/$ entry for more info on PCB production.
蚀刻酸用于对$(l:components/pcb)电路板/$进行化学蚀刻。蚀刻酸在$(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber)压力室/$中制造，并在$(l:manufacturing/etching_tank)蚀刻器/$中使用。$(p)有关电路板生产的更多信息，请参阅$(l:components/pcb)电路板/$词条。
